tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs drug pa bzhugs so// swasti shrī rastu ka lyā ṇa mi traṃ pra ṇa ba/ dpal bde legs su gyur cig dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rab tu bsngags so/ rnam dkar tshogs gnyis 'o ma'i chu gter ske rags dang ldan tshad med rin chen sna bzhi'i ba gam rab tu mdzes/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun sa yi zla ba'i khor yug kun nas kun du bskor zhing gnyis med gsung ba'i chos kyi snang ba can/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rta ljang can dang bdud rtsi'i 'od kyi nye bar gsal ba'i lhun po'i rgyal po skal ldan gling bzhi'i dbus na brjid/ /zab gsal rdo rje'i lcags ri rta gdong me yi ra bas legs par bskor ba'i phrin las 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag por 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mang du thos pa'i nags kyi sman ljongs ches cher yangs pa'i gnas su rigs pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i dmar ser ral pa'i khur gyis rnam par brjid la nges don zab mo'i de nyid gsal bar gzigs pa'i spyan mig bgrad de log par lta ba'i ri dwags phra mo mthar bar mdzad pa'i gdong lnga'i rgyal po/ sngon gyi dus su kha che'i paṇḍi ta ma hā shākya shrī bha dra'i dngos kyi slob ma chag lo tsā ba dgra bcom pa dang / ne pā le'i paṇḍi ta nyi ma'i dbang po'i slob ma chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/ mnyam med ye shes dpal bzang po la sogs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rim par brgyud pa'i chag gi rigs su sku 'khrungs nas phyi nang gi rigs pa'i gnas lnga legs par dgongs pa'i mkhas pa chen po/ phra zhing phra ba'i nyes ltung gi dri mas rnam par dben pa'i khrims kyi brtul zhugs nye bar gnas pa'i btsun pa'i mchog rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rim pa gnyis la thugs kyi brtan pa thob pa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po chag lo tsā ba gsum pa ratna dharm+ma rā dza zhes grags pa'i mtshan gyi ba dan dkar po srid rtse'i bar du bsgreng bar mdzad pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis legs par bltams pa'i tshul cung zad smos na/

thog mar rje btsun ma sgrol ma lha bcu bdun gyi dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ nyi ma sbas pa/ dā na shrī/ mañdzu shrī kīrti/ mal lo tsā ba/ su cer lo tsā ba/ la stod pa dbang phyug rin chen/ mchims chos seng ge/ blo gros brtan pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ bla brang ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bla brang ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bla brang ba bzang po dpal/ rje dpal chen bzang po/ rje ye shes dpal bzang po/ rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ ārya tā re/ ra bi gupta/ tsand+ra garbha/ bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ kun bzang rtse pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'phags pa nas/ bla ma khang ston/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ ngag dbang / byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri ba/ sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ slob dpon shākya 'od zer/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ chos rgyal grags pa 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/

zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ yar lung pa man 'dra'o/ /lha mo ti nu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ku ru kulle/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rnying pa gong mas mdzad pa dang / yang sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi tho/ /chos rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa/ lha mo ti nu'i yi ge rnying pa man ngag gces bsdus las 'byung ba dang / sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa thos so/ /dbyug gu ma spun gsum gyi sgrub thabs gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ tshogs sgom pa/ bsod nams brtan pa/ na bza' ba/ blo gros bzang po/ seng ge dpal ba/ kun bzang rtse pa/ gu ru ratna dharma rā dza/ des bdag la'o/ /dpal yang dag he ru ka mar me dgu pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang yang dag me gcig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i ring brgyud ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ long sku rdor sems/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ ro langs bde ba'i dngos grub/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ slob dpon chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi dra/ bal po shrī la mañdzu/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/

gnyag dzñā na ku ma rā/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen nas rim pa bzhin brgyud la/ nye brgyud ni/ dpal he ru ka slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ gtsug tor shes rab/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'od ldan dpal/ kun dga' rdo rje/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ mtshungs med nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ sa chen kun dga' snying po nas/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa shes rab blo gros/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ thog ston shes rdor man 'dra/ yang dag me dgu dang me gcig gi sgrub thabs gan pa rin rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ dkyil chog slob dpon hūm̐ ka ras mdzad pa thos/ go cha'i dpa' bo drug dang / dpa' mo drug gi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / badzra yo gi ni/ sha wa ra/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ mar pa do pa/ gze ba blo ldan seng ge/ don grub ye shes/ chos kyi blo gros/ rdor rgyal/ byang chen pa/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ de'i dbon po bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ rgod drug grags pa 'byung gnas/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ kun bzang rtse pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /gur lha brgyad dang / lha bcu gnyis ma gnyis ka'i thun mong gi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ shradhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ bkras lung pa/ dge sdings pa chen po/ sangs rgyas dpal/ rin chen gling pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ theg chen chos rgyal/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / drung dpal 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ dpal kun bzang rtse pa/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ bla brang pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje ye shes dpal bzang po/ rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ lo chen rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang de'i drung du gur lha bcu gnyis ma'i mngon rtogs mal lo tsā ba nas mal los mdzad kyang zer/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rjes mdzad par grags pa de yin brgyud pa/ 'gor/ bla ma mchog dang gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ zhes sogs yod pa dang / dkyil chog bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa yang thos/ yang gur bran bdud kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan bcu gnyis ma'i dbang dang 'dra/ de nas do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang / yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ tshem bu ba dpal ldan blo gros/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ kun bzang rtse pa/ lo chen rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag la'o/ /de'i sgrub thabs yi ge snying pa dang / rjes gnang yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can gyi man ngag rnams thos so/

/bcu gnyis skye 'gro'i nang tshan gyis/ /sna tshogs lha mo'i sdebs sbyor yin/ ratno gā ra thaku ṭe dza yot+sa ha madhyaṃ/ dharmā tsakra bārt+tīka rā dzakapa rā maṃ/ shrīnā mashtsa bāṃ dwībha ṣe bādi be bhū/ bha dra shtsa rā ṇā bhu dza mu ṇḍon mā mi/ /rin chen rgyal ba'i khang brtsegs nyams dga' bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po mchog /dpal gyi mtshan can skad gnyis smra ba'i gtso/ /bzang po'i zhabs pad yan lag mchog gis 'dud/ /rigs gnas rin chen rnam lnga'i khri la zhabs zung nyer gzhag nas/ /phan bde'i 'bras ldan dam chos mdzes ma stong gi lang tsho'i dpal/ /bden pa'i lam ston yid 'ongs rol sgeg du ma'i rnam 'gyur can/ /rig grol mkhas pa'i ded dpon gyis bsten chos kyi rgyal por bdud/ /gang gi mkhyen pa nyal 'gro'i gter/ /rna ba'i yur bar legs byas kyi/ /zla ba'i lag ma rab drangs nas/ /rmad byung lo tog ci yang rgyas/ /srid min srid pa'i dus kun tu/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus legs bzung ste/ /byams pa'i phangs par nyer 'tsho zhing / /ye shes spyan gyis btsal bar mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul dri ma med pa thos pa'i yi ge rin po che'i padma rā ga'i phreng ba las/ chag lo gsum pa ma hā paṇḍi ta ratna dharma rā dza shī bha drī zhal sngar/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam mchog dpal yang dag gi dbang sa lugs su mdzad pa me dgu/ me gcig sgrol ma bla med kyi phyi dkyil/ lus dkyil/ gur lha bcu gnyis kyi dbang / bran bdud nag po'i rjes gnang la sogs pa nye bar nos pa'i skabs te drug pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gsan yig skabs drug pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
